prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1304; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change on the highway. Insured vehicle contacted the claimant's vehicle on the driver's side. Claimant reports a shoulder injury and states they are not represented by an attorney. Recorded statements requested from both parties.

Entry 2: Spoke with the claimant by phone. Claimant describes pain and limited movement in the right shoulder and says they were evaluated at an urgent care facility. Claimant has not yet provided medical records. Explained the documentation needed to move the injury portion of the claim forward and provided a written list of items.

Entry 3: Received police report from the responding agency. Report notes the insured stated they checked mirrors but did not see the claimant's vehicle in the adjacent lane. Claimant's statement is consistent with the damage pattern on both vehicles. Liability assessment in progress.

Entry 4: Claimant called to ask whether they need to hire a lawyer. Advised that they are free to choose whether to be represented and that I can only provide information about the claims process. Claimant confirmed they will continue handling the claim directly. Medical authorization form sent to the claimant for signature.

Entry 5: Medical records received from the treating clinic, showing a diagnosis of a shoulder strain with a follow-up referral for imaging. Claimant reports the imaging appointment is scheduled. Reserve reviewed and adjusted pending results. Next follow-up set to check on imaging outcome and repair estimate status.
